name: Master-Bot
description: High-performance Discord bot and Next.js dashboard with zero-binary ioredis-mock and SQLite persistence.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Discord Bot Token from the Discord Developer Portal

NEXTAUTH_SECRET.description: Random 32+ character secret used to sign dashboard session tokens

PUBLIC_URL.description: The public HTTPS URL of your deployed application (e.g. https://your-app.herokuapp.com)

LAVA_ENABLED.description: Set to false by default on cloud hosts (requires external Lavalink for music)

LAVA_EXTERNAL.description: Defaults to true for cloud deployments to connect to an external Lavalink instance
